legacy_paraLockSync.name: Legacy paraLockSync Workflow
legacy_paraLockSync.description: Existing CKEditor plugin workflow remains the default and owns paragraph locks, polling, replacement apply, cursor lock updates, and unload cleanup when legacy mode is active.
table: CollaborationWorkflow resolves collaborative/off only from explicit URL or localStorage; otherwise legacy
paraLockSync registers with moduleSystem and exposes window.paraLock
selectionChange, editable contentDom events, and post-FullyLoaded loop send existing lockid updates through lockonly logic
Legacy workflow releases locks using existing close-session behavior
legacy_paraLockSync.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Resolve mode] --> B{legacy?}
    B -->|yes| C[Wait for CKEditor instanceReady]
    C --> D[Check collaboration eligibility]
    D --> E[Register paraLockSync]
    E --> F[Wait for FullyLoaded]
    F --> G[Resume legacy events and polling once]
    G --> H[Cursor sends lockid updates with stored lastSync]
    G --> I[Poll DB and apply locks/replacements]
    I --> J[Unload releases locks]
    B -->|no| K[Pause or skip legacy runtime]

collaborative_module.name: Collaborative Module Workflow
collaborative_module.description: Socket-first lock and DB-first replacement workflow where CollaborativeModule owns realtime paragraph locks and authoritative replacement sync.
table: context.js waits for DOMContentLoaded, moduleSystem, eligibility, and CKEditor readiness
CollaborativeModule attaches editor listeners and exposes window.CollaborativeModule/window.paraLock
BroadcastChannel uses collaborativeModule:<docid>; socket uses /collaboration?docid=<docid> from DOMAIN_ROOT
Cursor lock/release sends realtime notices and does not fetch get_lock_id
Dirty paragraph replacements reuse a pending uniqueId and write updated_html to DB before notices are sent
findupdatewithpush returns a small acknowledgement; it does not hydrate locks or replacements
Consumers fetch authoritative data by docid + uniqueId through getFilterdocs with a process-specific filter before applying changes
flagUpdate acknowledges replacement apply and lastSyncOnly updates lock lastSync without notification
collaborative_module.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Resolve collaborative mode] --> B[Wait for editor ready]
    B --> C[Start CollaborativeModule runtime]
    C --> D[Open BroadcastChannel and socket]
    D --> E[Cursor sends lock/release notice]
    E --> F[Remote applies lock without get_lock_id]
    D --> G[Reuse pending replacement uniqueId]
    G --> H[Dirty paragraph writes replacementOnly to DB]
    H --> I[Write endpoint returns ack only]
    I --> J[Notify same uniqueId only]
    J --> K[Remote fetches docid + uniqueId via getFilterdocs]
    K --> L[Apply replacement]
    L --> M[Send flagUpdate]
    L --> N[Send lastSyncOnly without notice]

mode_toggle.name: Local/UAT Runtime Mode Toggle
mode_toggle.description: Testing Mode control is available only after explicit collaborative opt-in; deployed UAT/default startup remains pure legacy.
table: Tester opens with collabMode=collaborative to register CollaborativeModule and its status dialog
Tester selects Legacy paraLockSync, Collaborative Module, or Off from the loaded dialog
Current legacy and collaborative runtimes are paused without disabling collaboration eligibility
Legacy resumes paraLockSync; collaborative opens transports; off exposes fallback
Repeated clicks do not duplicate intervals, listeners, sockets, or BroadcastChannels
mode_toggle.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Explicit collaborative opt-in] --> B[Register Collaborative Status]
    B --> C[Select testing mode]
    C --> D[Save per docid]
    D --> E[Pause both runtimes]
    E --> F{Mode}
    F -->|legacy| G[Resume paraLockSync only]
    F -->|collaborative| H[Start CollaborativeModule only]
    F -->|off| I[Expose safe fallback]
    G --> J[No page refresh]
    H --> J
    I --> J

runtime_mode_switch.name: Runtime Provider Pause And Resume
runtime_mode_switch.description: CollaborationWorkflow controls active operations while leaving feature eligibility and SHARED_KEY.collaborative unchanged.
table: Persists mode, pauses all providers, and starts only the selected provider
Public compatibility method that pauses providers rather than permanently disabling them
Clears polling intervals, pauses event actions, closes transports, stops heartbeat, exposes fallback
Resumes collaborative events, polling, presence, BroadcastChannel, and socket once
runtime_mode_switch.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[activateMode mode] --> B[Persist selected mode]
    B --> C[Pause legacy runtime]
    C --> D[Pause collaborative runtime]
    D --> E{Requested mode}
    E -->|off| F[Fallback paraLock]
    E -->|legacy| G[Resume paraLockSync]
    E -->|collaborative| H[Resume CollaborativeModule]
    H --> I[Connect BroadcastChannel and socket]

doc_scoped_socket.name: Doc-Scoped Socket Rooms
doc_scoped_socket.description: Java WebSocket endpoints isolate connected sessions by docid so notices do not cross documents.
table: Client opens /collaboration?docid=<docid>; /collab remains compatibility/test when deployed
Java endpoint reads docid from query string
Session is stored in a doc-scoped room map
Sender posts JSON text or binary/text compatibility payload
Endpoint sends only to other sessions in the same docid room
Session is removed from room on close/error
doc_scoped_socket.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Socket connect with docid] --> B[Parse query docid]
    B --> C[Add session to doc room]
    C --> D[Sender posts notice]
    D --> E[Broadcast to same docid only]
    E --> F[Close/error removes session]

db_first_replacement_sync.name: DB-First Replacement Sync
db_first_replacement_sync.description: Replacement notices contain uniqueId only; consumers fetch content from DB before applying paragraph updates.
table: _createReplacePush creates uniqueId and updated_html for DB/API
_sendToServer writes replacement data and receives a small ack
Consumer fetches by docid + replacements.uniqueId through getFilterdocs with filter projection
_applyReplacements updates content and flagUpdate acknowledges apply
The active provider advances lastSync from replacement response receive time and persists it without notifying transports
db_first_replacement_sync.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Paragraph edit] --> B[Build replacement payload]
    B --> C[Write authoritative DB row]
    C --> D[Notify uniqueId only]
    D --> E[Remote getFilterdocs by docid + uniqueId]
    E --> F[Capture response receive time]
    F --> G[Apply replacement]
    G --> H[Send flagUpdate]
    G --> I[Persist state lastSync with lastSyncOnly]

filtered_read_backend.name: getFilterdocs ParaLockSync Filtering
filtered_read_backend.description: Backend read/filter endpoint owns projection and lastSync replacement filtering; FindUpdatewithPush remains update/push only.
table: findupdatewithpush updates/pushes rows and returns r, id, process, and time_s only
getFilterdocs fetches matching documents like GetDocs
Requested top-level fields are copied from filter
Current user resolves from username, user, or find['locks.user']
Canonical locks[].lastSync is used with lowercase lastsync fallback
Exclude current-user replacements, skip already synced polling data, target uniqueId when requested, and keep latest replacement per paragraph
filtered_read_backend.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Frontend needs state] --> B[Call getFilterdocs]
    B --> C[Fetch matching docs]
    C --> D[Apply top-level filter]
    D --> E{tbl ParaLockSync?}
    E -->|no| F[Return projection]
    E -->|yes| G[Resolve user and lastSync]
    G --> H[Filter replacements]
    H --> I[Return filtered state]
    J[findupdatewithpush] --> K[Write only ack]

cursor_lock_update.name: Cursor Movement Lock Update
cursor_lock_update.description: Mouse and keyboard cursor movement update the current user's paragraph lock through DB in legacy mode and realtime notices in collaborative mode.
table: Both workflows listen to selectionChange and editable contentDom mouseup, keyup, and click
Cursor events defer selection handling so CKEditor selection has moved
Collapsed caret fallback walks from getStartElement to the nearest block with id
Legacy cursor path uses lockonly and sends existing lockid DB update
Collaborative cursor path sends lock/release over BroadcastChannel/socket without get_lock_id
Paused/off/inactive providers do not write cursor locks
cursor_lock_update.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Cursor moves] --> B[selectionChange or contentDom event]
    B --> C[Queue lockonly]
    C --> D[Resolve paragraph id]
    D --> E{Provider active?}
    E -->|no| F[Skip]
    E -->|legacy| G[Send DB lockid]
    E -->|collaborative| H[Send realtime lock notice]

lastSyncOnly.name: Common lastSyncOnly Process
lastSyncOnly.description: After replacement apply, the active provider persists the replacement response-received timestamp as the current user's lock lastSync without emitting any socket or BroadcastChannel notice.
table: _afterReplacementProcess runs after replacement content is applied
Process runs only when legacy or collaborative provider is active
Find current doc/user lock row and update locks.$.lastSync from provider state
Collaborative notify path ignores lastSyncOnly; legacy has no socket or BroadcastChannel notify
lastSyncOnly does not create replacement rows or acknowledgement flags
lastSyncOnly.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Replacement response received] --> B[Apply replacement]
    B --> C{Provider active?}
    C -->|no| D[Skip]
    C -->|yes| E[Store response time in state]
    E --> F[Send lastSyncOnly]
    F --> G[Update lock lastSync]
    G --> H[No broadcast or socket notice]

request_based_shared_key_enablement.name: Request-Based Shared Key Enablement
request_based_shared_key_enablement.description: Collaboration enablement is explicit through enableCollaborativeSharedKey; loadSharedKey only loads and normalizes stored data.
table: loadSharedKey reads xmleditor:shared:${docid} and assigns SHARED_KEY
xmleditor:collabEnabled:${docid} does not silently change SHARED_KEY.collaborative during load
Helper stores patched shared key, collabEnabled=true, and collabMode=collaborative
Callback tells caller whether reload is required
request_based_shared_key_enablement.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[initDocumentID] --> B[loadSharedKey]
    B --> C[initUserInfo]
    B --> D[No automatic collaborative patch]
    E[Explicit enable request] --> F[Patch SHARED_KEY collaborative yes]
    F --> G[Persist keys]
    G --> H[Callback reloadRequired]
